Perfect for collectors, creative decorators, or anyone seeking unique historical pieces, these glass insulators feature a mix of eye-catching aqua blue and classic clear finishes. Each one is sturdy, visually striking, and showcases embossed Hemingray branding, highlighting their authentic heritage as classic American utility artifacts. The set includes three aqua blue insulators and six clear glass insulators, each with a round, beaded base and smooth finish that speaks to timeless craftsmanship. Use them as decorative accents, paperweights, creative upcycled projects, or for educational display. Their robust glass construction ensures long-lasting durability. Trust in these genuine pieces of Americana to add charm and history to your space. These insulators were proudly made in the United States and offer a sustainable, eco-friendly way to repurpose vintage materials.

Natural Quartz Geode Specimen Rough Gray Exterior 4 Inch Diameter

description:
Mixed Natural Mineral and Rock Specimens Lot Quartz Calcite Chert Flint
This lot contains unpolished natural mineral and rock specimens suitable for collectors, educational use, or lapidary projects. Included are a large white quartz crystal, multiple pieces of brownish chert or flint, a yellow calcite crystal, and assorted tumbled and rough stones of various sizes and colors. The specimens are in raw, unprocessed condition with natural fractures and rough edges visible. The rocks range from small pebbles to larger hand-sized pieces. The lot is contained in a clear plastic container for easy sorting and examination. No brand or model is associated.

Local Pickup Service:
Must be scheduled online in advance of pickup
Our location is 2701 Wilmarco Ave. Baltimore, Md. 21223. - Call upon arrival to Dock #20  443-708-4234 xt 5115
Pickup appointments are scheduled M-F 9am-3pm
All orders must be paid for online prior to pick up.
Unpaid items:
All auctions will be
automatically
relisted once the payment deadline expires.

description:
Vintage Mickey Mouse Playful Pen from Mickey's Stuff for Kids line by Sunkisses Hawaii Ltd. Officially licensed by Disney. Packaging shows tape residue and slight discoloration. Pen appears new and unused. Collectible item for Disney memorabilia or vintage character stationery collectors.
